items.title: The Making of the Game of Thrones Pilot was a Sh*t Show
items.description:
Making high fantasy television is hard. Let’s talk about how difficult it was to make the pilot of Game of Thrones, from the showrunners producing a terrible first episode to recasting the iconic Daenerys Targaryen.

You can also listen to this episode (and more) in podcast form!

items.title: U.S. NAVAL ACADEMY "THE FIRST YEAR" 1970s U.S. NAVY PROMOTIONAL MOVIE 52324
items.description: Directed by Bruce Seth Green,  "Annapolis: The First Year" shows the U.S. Naval Academy in the mid-to-late 1970s. This portrait supposedly shows the 1976 plebe year, but also includes footage from later classes in an attempt to show that the Academy had becoming sexually integrated.
